traits.name: Arcanic Study
traits.effect: A higher form of arcane education. Gives your Mage base class and any Mage promoted class you have an extra Skill Point.

traits.name: Bad Egg
traits.effect: Made for trouble. Gives your Rogue base class and any Rogue promoted class you have an extra Skill Point.

traits.name: Daily Prayer
traits.effect: Follows the scripture. Gives your Curate base class and any Curate promoted class you have an extra Skill Point.

traits.name: Fencing Study
traits.effect: Researched proper form. Gives your Duelist base class and any Duelist promoted class you have an extra Skill Point.

traits.name: Marksman
traits.effect: A trained shooter. Gives your Archer base class and any Archer promoted class you have an extra Skill Point.

traits.name: Mercenary Work
traits.effect: Some history as a mercenary. Gives your Soldier base class and any Soldier promoted class you have an extra Skill Point.

traits.name: Song Writer
traits.effect: Skilled song author. Gives your Bard base class and any Bard promoted class you have an extra Skill Point.

traits.name: Spirit Caller
traits.effect: An experienced caller of souls. Gives your Summoner base class and any Summoner promoted class you have an extra Skill Point.

traits.name: Spiritual Fighter
traits.effect: A skilled unarmed fighter. Gives your Martial Artist base class and any Martial Artist promoted class you have an extra Skill Point.

traits.name: Animal Allergy
traits.effect: Being near an animal-like race may cause you to sneeze involuntarily sometimes. If this occurs in battle, the sneeze may have a minor special effect (When triggered, the icon state 'sneeze' will be used).

traits.name: Arrow Catcher
traits.effect: When you are attacked by a Bow weapon and evade the attack, there is a 75% chance for you to catch the arrow, and if you do; All Bow weapons you have equipped recover 5 Durability. If it was an elemental arrow, you also gain a stack of that type of arrow, provided you don't have any elemental arrows active.

traits.name: Attune With Nature
traits.effect: The cost to equip Racial skills in the Skill Pool becomes 0.

traits.name: Battle Rush
traits.effect: At the start of battle, you gain Battle Rush LV5 for 3 Rounds, which boosts your Power by LV. Defeating an enemy extends it by 3 Rounds. When it expires, you become Worn Out for 3 rounds, increasing the FP costs by the same amount.

traits.name: Battle Spirits
traits.effect: The act of beating up enemies elates you, allowing you to restore 1 FP every time you hit with a basic attack. (2 FP if it was a critical hit.)

traits.name: Blind Fighting
traits.effect: Blind statuses you suffer only reduce your hit by 25% instead of 50%, halving its effectiveness.

traits.name: Burned Body
traits.effect: Since you've already been burned once, you gain +5% Status Resistance versus Burn, and 25% resistance versus Singe wounds.

traits.name: Charismatic
traits.effect: Grants a special skill called Motivate (Charisma). (Boosts Critical for all allies by Scaled WIL - 10 until your next turn. 3 Round Cooldown.)

traits.name: Competitive
traits.effect: When you deal damage to an enemy, if it's the highest amount of damage that has been dealt during this battle, you gain Competitive Hubris LV 10, which increases Status Resistance by 10%. This status lasts the entirety of the battle, or until someone (ally or enemy) outdoes your sick damage.

traits.name: Crude Chivalry
traits.effect: Allows you to apply the effects of Chivalry subtalents even if you outnumber the enemy's party.

traits.name: Cursed Blood
traits.effect: Reduces your Status Resistance by 10% and prevents you from donating blood. However, enemies who drink your blood or absorb your HP have a chance to have a status effect dispelled. May also interact with certain blood-based skills in a unique way.

traits.name: Dedicated Cleaner
traits.effect: G6: Increases the reputation bonus and maximum possible reputation gained from cleaning up battle damage. Cleaning battle damage generates a sparkly shine, which makes it harder for more damage to tarnish your nice and clean city street. Korvara: Increases effectiveness of repairing battle damage.

traits.name: Desperado Striker
traits.effect: If you perform a basic attack with a weapon that has exactly 1 Durability remaining, that attack will always critically hit if successful, breaking the weapon in the process.

traits.name: Die Hard
traits.effect: You have a 5+LUC% chance while incapacitated to revive with HP equal to your level. This effect can only activate once every 10 Rounds.

traits.name: Discard Weapon
traits.effect: Grants the skill Discard Weapon (Main/Sub) in combat.

traits.name: Disgraced Knight
traits.effect: Your Chivalry' effects are only half as effective. You may be able to redeem yourself. (Progress towards Recovered Honor will be displayed on this trait when it happens.)

traits.name: Enemy of Locks
traits.effect: Increases the success rate when picking any lock by 15%.

traits.name: Escape Artist
traits.effect: Grants +10% success rate when attempting to Flee, and lowers the success rate of enemies trying to Grapple you by 15%.

traits.name: Exaggerator
traits.effect: Grants the skill Exaggerate in battle. (Grants a status-infliction based chance to inflict Hesitation LV 20 to all enemies in the battle for 3 Rounds. Every enemy who buys it recovers your Momentum by 1 (up to a max of 3). (80% normal infliction rate + Scaled STR%, because its more convincing if you look the part.) 10 Round CD)

traits.name: Fast Healer
traits.effect: +50% recovery at campfires, +25% healing through food, +50% healing rate of wounds. You get hungry more often, though, decreasing the duration of common foods by 2 battles (to a min. of 1).

traits.name: Further Madness
traits.effect: Once per battle, hearing the Mantra word causes your next basic attack to have +8 Power. While in battle, hearing the mantra will also cause you to laugh when this is triggered. (The laughing emote will use the face icon state 'madness_trait', if you wish to specify a custom one in your face icon.)

traits.name: Ghost Entertainer
traits.effect: Prevents Spiritualism spirits from leaving your body when you are defeated in battle. Furthermore, Performing near lingering spirits grants you Roleplaying EXP (this can only trigger once every 3 in-game hours).

traits.name: Gourmet
traits.effect: Improves the HP regen, FP regen, and duration of foods with a total HP+FP regen of 30 or more by 5 each.

traits.name: Green Lover
traits.effect: Food Lover Trait. (only one can be selected.) When eating a food that contains vegetables or fruit, the HP regen, FP regen, and Duration are all boosted by 2.

traits.name: Guardian Care
traits.effect: After every battle, your Guardian Spirit is healed to full HP and FP.

requirements.raw: Guardian Spirit Trait, First Aid Talent Rank 3+

traits.name: Guardian Spirit
traits.effect: You have made an unofficial alliance with a guardian spirit, a Youkai ally that you can summon in battle (even if you aren't a Summoner). They will begin at level 10 and 100 Friendship, but if you lose this trait, they will also leave, so be careful. If you have a Starsign, the type of Youkai might change. (Mars = Chun, Jupiter = Byakko, Venus = Jack o' Lantern, Mercury = Snow Crow, Venus = Hippogriph, Neptune = Drowned Woman, Uranus = Apus, Pluto = Lilu, Other/None = Asrai)

traits.name: Guardian Spirit (Alt)
traits.effect: You have made an unofficial alliance with a guardian spirit, a Youkai ally that you can summon in battle (even if you aren't a Summoner). They will begin at level 10 and 100 Friendship, but if you lose this trait, they will also leave, so be careful. If you have a Starsign, the type of Youkai might change. (Mars = Suzaku, Jupiter = Kilkenny, Venus = Carbuncle, Mercury = Yukionna, Venus = Seiryuu, Neptune = Sazae Oni, Uranus = Izabe, Pluto = Wawa, Other/None = Firefox)

traits.name: Heart Breaker
traits.effect: You know how to use your assets, giving you a +5% Charm infliction rate. Furthermore, inflicting Charm on an enemy fills you with glee, restoring 10 FP (once per Round).

traits.name: Instant Guardian
traits.effect: Grants the skill Instant Guardian (which must be equipped in your skill pool. (At the start of battle, you automatically summon your Guardian Spirit to a tile next to you (if available). This skill does not stack with Auto-Summon, and that skill will take priority over this one. Equipping this skill does not take up a skill pool slot.))

requirements.raw: Guardian Spirit Trait, Summoning Talent Rank 3+

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.effect: Negates the effects of other characters' Quiet Person traits, letting you hear them without them mumbling.

traits.name: Laidback Disposition
traits.effect: Disposition Trait. (only one can be selected.) +10% Resistance versus Fear and Silence. -10% Resistance versus Charm and Hesitation.

traits.name: Last Rites
traits.effect: Grants a 10% chance that monsters you encounter in dungeons/etc will also leave behind a Spiritualism spirit.

traits.name: Loud Person
traits.effect: The range of your say and shout are increased by 2 tiles. You're also hard to shut up, much to the displeasure of others, granting +10% Status Resistance versus Silence effects caused by monsters.

traits.name: Lovely Face
traits.effect: Passively increases reputation by 10, and grants a special skill in battle called Blow Kiss. (Blow a kiss at an enemy within 5 Range, granting a chance to inflict Charm LV X (X = Scaled WIL) for 3 Rounds. +20% infliction rate if you are wearing an unarmored torso (this gives them a better... view.))

requirements.raw: 10 WIL, 15 GUI, Non-Corrupted Race with Natural Skin

traits.name: Luminary Element
traits.effect: WIL no longer increases all elements; instead, it increases your Starsign's element by 1 per 1 WIL (for Elem ATK only, diminishing returns are ignored). The original stat that grants a bonus to this element no longer does so.

traits.name: Madness Mantra
traits.effect: You pick a name that is 4-18 letters long when you gain this trait. Whenever someone else has this trait and you hear it, it will be highlighted in red and agitate you. (Has no gameplay effect with only this trait.)

traits.name: Mana Replenishment
traits.effect: At the start of a new round, if your current FP is equal to or less than twice your Scaled SAN, you gain +5 FP Regeneration for that round.

traits.name: Managerial Skills
traits.effect: Increases the amount of Mercenaries you can bring into battle by 1 (you can normally only bring 3 at once).

traits.name: Maneuver: Ambidexterity
traits.effect: Grants access to a special passive skill. This passive skill is a toggle that you can equip in your skill pool for free which makes it possible to specify which weapon you want to use for skills requiring specific weapon types. While the skill is off, you will prefer to use your main weapon when possible; while on, you will prefer to use your sub weapon. (Note that this doesn't make it possible to use invalid weapon types with skills you couldn't otherwise do so with.)

traits.name: Maneuver: Special Attack 1
traits.effect: Grants access to a special skill in combat. The skill granted is unique to the weapon type equipped in your main hand (if you change the weapon, this skill will also change).

traits.name: Mantra of Will
traits.effect: In battle, grants the skill Mantra of Will. (10 round CD. You gain Mantra of Will for this round only; however, after using the skill your character must say something that grants them the force of will necessary. This could be a battle cry, calling out an attack name, or something specific to the situation. Just make it cool! (Mantra of Will expires after triggering a Special Strike.))

traits.name: Mask of Metal
traits.effect: While you have a Helmet' accessory and a Heavy Armor torso equipped, enemies will not be able to see your HP, FP, and so on. Non-PC enemies will not be able to determine your race for special effects, either.

traits.name: Masseuse
traits.effect: Once per in-game day, in the Companions panel, you can give a Youkai ally a massage. This massage gives them EXP equal to X% of the total EXP they need to level up (X = your SKI), and also increases their Friendship with you.

traits.name: Master of Unlocking
traits.effect: Further increases the success rate when picking a lock by 10%. In addition, the chance for a lockpick to break on failure is halved.

traits.name: Mastery of Weapon Arts
traits.effect: All weapons you use that do not have STR as their main scaling stat gain +15% STR scaling.

traits.name: Meat Lover
traits.effect: Food Lover Trait. (only one can be selected.) When eating a food that contains meat or fish, the HP regen, FP regen, and Duration are all boosted by 2.

traits.name: Merciful Soul
traits.effect: Grants a skill called Show Mercy; when used in battle, enemies will have the chance to leave the battle. Player characters can choose to leave the battle. Otherwise, depending on the race and remaining HP', monsters may Flee. If they do so, you will still recieve EXP as if you defeated them, plus bonus RP EXP. They may also leave behind items when they flee. Does not work against bosses or in arena battles.

traits.name: Monster Hunter
traits.effect: Increases attack damage dealt by melee weapons against monsters by 15%.

traits.name: Ninja Training
traits.effect: Unlocks the Ninjutsu Talent, which deals with Smokescreens and Shurikens.

traits.name: Obsessive Madness
traits.effect: At the start of a battle, if a unit other than yourself has a name that contains the mantra word, you become obsessed with them (which ends if they reach 0 HP and the effect would trigger). While obsessed, you gain Further Madness every round, your healing and damage to that unit is increased by 10%/5% respectively, and you will turn to face them frequently.

traits.name: Offensive Discard
traits.effect: When the character uses Discard Weapon (Main/Sub), the Range increases by 5, and it can target an enemy, throwing it at them, which deals armor-ignoring damage equal to the weapon's Power of it's damage type. If the weapon was broken, it becomes bonus damage.

traits.name: One-Handed
traits.effect: You can't equip sub-weapons, and can't two-hand weapons either. However, since you're better practiced with one hand, you gain +5 hit (treated as base, not bonus). (Adds a note to your character's profile mentioning your missing hand.)

traits.name: Persistence of Normalcy
traits.effect: If your Main Class and Sub Class are both Base Classes, you gain +100 Max HP. If they are the same Base Class, you gain +200 Max HP instead.

requirements.raw: Character Level 30, or at least 1 Legend Extension

traits.name: Poison Resilience
traits.effect: Increases Poison Resistance by 5%, and reduces the LV of any Poison effect applied to you by 1 (cannot go below LV1). (Only applies to enemy effects.)

traits.name: Power of Normalcy
traits.effect: If your Main Class and Sub Class are both Base Classes, you gain +4 to all stats (except APT). If they are the same Base Class, you gain +8 to all stats instead.

requirements.raw: Character Level 30, or at least 1 Legend Extension

traits.name: Quick Temper
traits.effect: It doesn't take much to make this character angry. Even the act of getting in a battle pisses them off, activating your Ruled by Emotion trait at the start of one.

traits.name: Quiet Person
traits.effect: People at the edge of your say range can only hear you mumbling. However, monsters in dungeons will not notice you when you are in their line of sight unless you are fairly close.

traits.name: Reckless Rescuer
traits.effect: Joining a battle mid-way grants +15 Scaled Weapon Attack as you bravely charge into the fray, but lowers your Phys. and Mag. Defense by 10% due to your recklessness. This effect lasts for 3 Rounds.

traits.name: Recovered Honor
traits.effect: Can only be taken after applying the effects of Chivalry's Talents 500 times. You have managed to reclaim your honor, negating the effects of Disgraced Knight. Sometimes the only reward you need is correcting your past mistakes.

traits.name: Ruled By Emotion
traits.effect: While inflicted with Fear, your Hit against the inflictor is decreased by an additional 10, but your Evade is increased by 10 against all attacks, as you are trying to protect yourself. Conversely, when you are angered, your Scaled Weapon Attack increases by 15, but your Armor is lowered by 15, as you are less concerned with such things. (You become angry when an ally is defeated, when you miss a basic attack, or when an enemy inflicts a luck-based status effect on you. When applied this way it lasts for 2 Rounds, and cannot be reapplied during that time.)

traits.name: Sadism
traits.effect: Increases the chance you inflict Wounds on enemies by 50% of its normal value, and upon doing so successfully, the enjoyment you feel restores 10 FP.

traits.name: Sentimentality (Weapon)
traits.effect: Using the weapon in your main hand grants bonus effects the more battles you take it into, including +1 Power, Critical, Hit, +5 Maximum Durability, 25% bonus EXP towards its Potential unlock and 5% Durability usage reduction. At 100 battles, all of these bonuses are doubled. (Each bonus unlocks after a certain number of battles; if you end a battle with a different main hand weapon equipped, all benefits will RESET!)

traits.name: Serious Disposition
traits.effect: Disposition Trait. (only one can be selected.) +10% Resistance versus Charm and Hesitation. -10% Resistance versus Fear and Silence.

traits.name: Servant Training
traits.effect: G6: Doubles the speed of cleaning up battle damage in towns, and increases the EXP gained for it by 10%. Korvara: Increases effectiveness of repairing battle damage.

traits.name: Sixth Sense
traits.effect: Monsters that get back attacks against your party do not get a bonus round.

traits.name: Smasher
traits.effect: Doubles damage to field objects that can be attacked, and slightly increases the success rate of bashing doors open.

traits.name: Sneaky Kick
traits.effect: Allows your Kick skill to scale the higher of your STR or GUI stat, and if used while you are Sneaking on an enemy you are directly behind of, the damage will critically hit.

traits.name: Specialization
traits.effect: When your Main Class and Sub Class are the same Class your maximum Skill Pool size is increased by 4.

traits.name: Specialized Attack
traits.effect: When you select the trait, you also select 1 Offensive skill from a class which has more than 1 Rank, that you currently have equipped. This skill becomes your 'special technique' and it gains +1 effective Rank (doesn't stack with white spirits). Additionally, if your special technique is the only Offensive Skill equipped in your skill pool, if it has a cooldown, it's reduced by 2 rounds (min. 1 round).

requirements.raw: Specialization Trait, Combat Drilling Talent Rank 3+

traits.name: Spiritual Sensitivity
traits.effect: Against Possessed and Ghost enemies, you gain +10% Status Infliction as you can more easily influence them, but also -10% Status Resistance due to your sensitivity. You will also be able to see Spirits regardless of your Spiritualism ranks.

traits.name: Stability
traits.effect: Grants 1 HP Regen per round. The effect is doubled if you're below 50% HP.

traits.name: Strict Sleeper
traits.effect: You pick an hour between 1 and 24; this is your bedtime. Resting at an inn within 1 hour of your bedtime refreshes you, restoring 50% of your max Phys and Mental Stamina (once a day)). If you miss this window, you become Strictly Sleepy, increasing your chance to receive wounds by 10% until you rest at an inn.

traits.name: Strongest Muscles
traits.effect: While you do not have a Torso item equipped, you gain +10 Armor, +10 Magic Armor, and 10% Blunt Resistance. You also gain the skill Cast Off Flexing (Flex so hard that whatever's on your upper body goes flying off, unequipping your Torso equipment slot item. If there was one, all enemies might be inflicted with Hesitation LV 50 until your next turn, because good lord look at them biceps).

requirements.raw: 30 STR, 30 VIT, Race with Natural Skin

traits.name: Sword Polisher
traits.effect: When your party rests at an inn, you polish their weapons, which has two effects. First, if you have any Maintenance Talents, it'll repair them as if it had triggered. Second, all members receive a buff that reduces Durability consumption for weapons by 25% for 50 Rounds. Korvara: Also increases effectiveness of repairing battle damage.

traits.name: Trap Dismantler
traits.effect: Increases the success rate of disarming traps by 20% and halves chance to trigger it when failing to do so.

traits.name: Trap Scouter
traits.effect: Increases the success rate of spotting traps by 15%.

traits.name: Trickster
traits.effect: Boosts activation chance of Trickery effects by 5%. When you activate a Trickery effect you recover 10 FP (once per round).

traits.name: Undeniable Innovator
traits.effect: Increases Skill Pool maximum to 99, allows any weapons to be equipped regardless of class, and allows you to use the Main Class skills of your Sub Class.

traits.name: Undeniable Toughness
traits.effect: The first time you are defeated in battle, revive with 50% of Max HP and 0 Momentum, but gain Worn out (LV 10, 4 rounds), Max HP Down (LV 50, 4 rounds), and Tough But Weak (LV 25, 2 rounds). The second time, revive with 25% of max HP and 0 Momentum, but gain Clumsy (8 rounds), Max HP Down (LV 75, 8 rounds), and Tough But Weak (LV 50, 2 rounds). You still gain Badly Beaten and other revival effects take priority.

traits.name: Weapon Telepathy
traits.effect: You will sometimes hear thoughts from your weapons. If you have Sentimentality (Weapon), sentimentality builds between you and weapons twice as fast.

traits.name: Workhorse
traits.effect: You are built for manual labor, increasing your maximum Physical Stamina by 50.

requirements.raw: SR 5 in Trenchman, Fieldworker, or Lumberjack

traits.name: History: Assassin
traits.effect: +2 SKI, +1 LUC

traits.name: History: Faithful
traits.effect: +2 FAI, +1 RES

traits.name: History: Fencer
traits.effect: +2 CEL, +1 DEF

traits.name: History: Gambler
traits.effect: +2 LUC, +1 STR

traits.name: History: Ghost
traits.effect: +2 RES, +1 CEL

traits.name: History: Hero
traits.effect: +2 STR, +1 LUC

traits.name: History: Knight
traits.effect: +2 VIT, +1 DEF

traits.name: History: Magician
traits.effect: +2 WIL, +1 CEL

traits.name: History: Marauder
traits.effect: +2 VIT, +1 LUC

traits.name: History: Myrmidon
traits.effect: +2 SKI, +1 CEL

traits.name: History: Priest
traits.effect: +2 FAI, +1 WIL

traits.name: History: Shaman
traits.effect: +2 DEF, +1 WIL

traits.name: History: Spellblade
traits.effect: +2 WIL, +1 STR

traits.name: History: Survivor
traits.effect: +2 LUC, +1 VIT

traits.name: History: Thief
traits.effect: +2 CEL, +1 LUC

traits.name: History: Ward
traits.effect: +2 DEF, +1 RES

traits.name: History: Warrior
traits.effect: +2 STR, +1 SKI

traits.name: History: Witchhunter
traits.effect: +2 RES, +1 STR

traits.name: Albedo Operative
traits.effect: You are capable of utilising secret portals or hacking the Majistran portal service to teleport to the Albedo Headquarters, located at an unknown place underground. Note: Do not take this trait if you are not intending to RP a member of this organisation.

traits.name: Minor Nobility
traits.effect: Increases your starting reputation with all regions by 20.

requirements.raw: Level 1 Only (Effect only relevant in Great Six)

traits.name: Pious Upbringing
traits.effect: +50% recovery at campfires, +25% healing through food, +50% healing rate of wounds. You get hungry more often, though, decreasing the duration of common foods by 2 battles (to a min. of 1).

requirements.raw: 5 FAI, 1+ SR in Prayer (Great Six Only)

traits.name: Preacher
traits.effect: Once per day, you can use the Preach verb (similar to say, etc.) to preach to all characters in an earshot about how great your God is. Characters who are following the same religion will become closer to the God, increasing their God Loyalty by 1. For each, you gain RP EXP equal to 1% of your next level's required amount (to a maximum of 5%).

traits.name: Tribe - Galjager
traits.effect: Regional Trait. (Only one can be selected.) Based on your total Detainment rank, the penalties for Capture. and the cost to Convert mercenaries are reduced.

traits.name: Tribe - Hawu
traits.effect: Regional Trait. (Only one can be selected.) Based on your total Maintenance rank, the repair limit for Service increases, and the Momentum cost of Emergency Service decreases. Additionally, Duyuei allies being defeated enrages them for 3 Rounds, gaining increased damage.

traits.name: Tribe - Imala
traits.effect: Regional Trait. (Only one can be selected.) Based on your total First Aid rank, your Healing subtalent heals for more, and you can treat certain wounds without items by spending Mental Stamina.

traits.name: Tribe - Skouge
traits.effect: Regional Trait. (Only one can be selected.) Based on your total rank of your Altermancy and Solmancy talents, the efficiency of the opposite talent is increased. Makes interactions with Spiritualism spirits easier.

traits.name: Absolute Disaster
traits.effect: If you harness both Channel Magic and Channel Destruction to use Fire Breath, the fire will increase in size every two tiles, hitting a much wider area, and it gains an additional 50% Fire ATK to its damage dealt.

traits.name: Agile Accel Booster
traits.effect: Mech Type Trait. (only one can be selected) If you do not have any legs item equipped, grants a skill in battle called Agile Accel. (1M. 1 round CD. Become Airborne and move in a 2-5 Range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. For 3 Rounds your boosters are considered overheating, causing you to take 15 non-resistable, non-absorbable Fire damage if you use the skill again. 15 damage is added and the duration is reset every time it's used while it is overheating.)

traits.name: Ancient Agility
traits.effect: Ancient Song Trait. (only one can be selected) Changes the effect of Ancient Song's activation: it will instead grant allies +Y Move and +X Evade (1 Attack) for 1 round. (Y = half of Ancient Song LV, X = Ancient Song LV * 10)

traits.name: Ancient Fervor
traits.effect: Ancient Song Trait. (only one can be selected) Changes the effect of Ancient Song's activation: it will instead grant allies +X Hit and +X Critical for 1 round. (X = Ancient Song LV * 5)

traits.name: Arcane Relocation
traits.effect: Toggle skill. While toggled on, the Lich's movement becomes Teleportation (you appear instantly at your target location, bypassing the need to walk and set off field hazards).

traits.name: Big Cheese
traits.effect: Cheese Trait. (only one can be selected) When applied to your goons with the Little Cheese trait, Tactician Order skills get +5 LV (+1 for Charge Order) and Motivate (Charisma) gets +15 LV, because you're the boss and what you say goes. When you're above 0 HP, and those goons do something useful (gettin' the loot via Muridae Instinct, applying a Steal skill successfully to take 'em what fors, or takin' a hit for you via redirection effects), you gain +5 FP.

traits.name: Blood Binding: Avian
traits.effect: Karakuri Youkai trait (only 1 selectable). The youkai bound to the Karakuri is an Avian youkai, giving them +3 GUI, +2 CEL, -3 WIL, and -2 DEF. It also grants +15 Wind Resistance, but a 15% Lightning Weakness.

traits.name: Blood Binding: Beast
traits.effect: Karakuri Youkai trait (only 1 selectable). The youkai bound to the Karakuri is an Avian youkai, giving them +3 SKI, +2 LUC, -3 RES, and -2 GUI. It also grants +15% Lightning Resistance, but a 15% Fire Weakness.

traits.name: Blood Binding: Dragon
traits.effect: Karakuri Youkai trait (only 1 selectable). The youkai bound to the Karakuri is an Avian youkai, giving them +3 STR, +2 DEF, -3 CEL, and -2 RES. It also grants +15% Fire Resistance, but a 15% Wind Weakness.

traits.name: Blood Binding: Fairy
traits.effect: Karakuri Youkai trait (only 1 selectable). The youkai bound to the Karakuri is an Avian youkai, giving them +3 CEL, +2 LUC, -3 STR, and -2 WIL. It also grants +15% Light Resistance, but a 15% Dark Weakness.

traits.name: Blood Binding: Mystic
traits.effect: Karakuri Youkai trait (only 1 selectable). The youkai bound to the Karakuri is an Avian youkai, giving them +3 WIL, +2 SKI, -3 STR, and -2 RES. It also grants +15% Ice Resistance, but a 15% Earth Weakness.

traits.name: Blood Binding: Night
traits.effect: Karakuri Youkai trait (only 1 selectable). The youkai bound to the Karakuri is an Avian youkai, giving them +3 RES, +2 GUI, -3 DEF, and -2 FAI. It also grants +15% Dark Resistance, but a 15% Light Weakness.

traits.name: Blood Binding: Plant
traits.effect: Karakuri Youkai trait (only 1 selectable). The youkai bound to the Karakuri is an Avian youkai, giving them +3 DEF, +2 VIT, -3 GUI, and -2 LUC. It also grants +15% Earth Resistance, but a 15% Ice Weakness.

traits.name: Bright Darkness
traits.effect: Lowers the multiplier of the Holy enchant when used against you by 5%.

traits.name: Chilling Fangs
traits.effect: Vampire Fangs Trait. (only one can be selected) Not all fangs are made equally. Yours make your prey's blood run cold, causing your Banquet skill to have a chance of inflicting Frostbite LV X (X = 10 + Scaled SAN) for 3 Rounds.

traits.name: Chronicling Cabal Memory
traits.effect: Mech Type Trait. (only one can be selected) For each accessory equipment slot that you have empty, the Skill Pool cost of Spells is reduced by 0.5.

traits.name: Cloud Rend
traits.effect: Black Rend Trait. (only one can be selected) Increases Black Rend's FP cost by 5, but it will now toss the enemy you use it on into the air, making them Airborne.

traits.name: Concealed Compartment
traits.effect: Karakuri Compartment trait (only 1 selectable). Karakuri often possess the ability to conceal small objects in hollow compartments of their body. This grants the Karakuri an extra Item Belt slot, letting them equip an additional battle item.

traits.name: Concealed Explosive
traits.effect: Karakuri Compartment trait (only 1 selectable). Karakuri often possess the ability to conceal small objects in hollow compartments of their body. In this case, the Karakuri's familiarity with small explosives means that at the start of battle, they gain Concealed Explosive (LV 1, permanent duration). (Grants a skill that lets you throw a bomb, which then lowers the LV of this effect by 1.)

traits.name: Constrictor Snake
traits.effect: Naga Wrap trait. (only one can be selected) Wrap's FP cost increases by 10, but if you use it on an enemy you are Restraining or Grappling, it inflicts Silence on them for 2 rounds.

traits.name: Cornered Rat
traits.effect: Instinct Trait. (only one can be selected) When you trigger Muridae Instinct's On Attacked effect, you fight back, gaining +5 Scaled Weapon Attack and +10 Critical for 2 rounds. However, this also puts Muridae Instinct on a 2 round CD.

traits.name: Corrupted Ink
traits.effect: The maximum HP reduction applied by tattoo traits is halved.

traits.name: Dark Mantis Strike
traits.effect: Black Rend Trait. (only one can be selected) Increases Black Rend's FP cost by 5, but also makes it Airborne Compatible, and reduces the momentum cost by 1 while Airborne. However, it also gains a 1 round cooldown.

traits.name: Deadly Duo
traits.effect: The Red and Blue Oni are most dangerous when working together. When an Oni with Oni Heritage (Red) and another Oni with Oni Heritage (Blue) are in the same party, and those Oni have Deadly Duo, all Oni with Deadly Duo in the party gain Deadly Oni Duo (LV 2, permanent) on battle start. (Deadly Oni Duo: Boosts the damage dealt by Hazing Blood by LV x 5, the Armor and Parry reduction of Thundering Blows by LV x 1, and the damage boost and reduction of Graceless Destruction by LV x 1.)

traits.name: Deep Diver
traits.effect: You use up less of your stamina when diving, reducing its physical stamina cost by 2.

traits.name: Dirty Rat
traits.effect: Instinct Trait. (only one can be selected) When you trigger Muridae Instinct's On Attacked effect, you throw Something Shiny where the sun don't shine, dealing X (X = 5 + half of character LV) Blunt armor-ignoring damage, which can critically hit, to your attacker. However this also puts Muridae Instinct on a 2 turn CD.

traits.name: Disaster Potential
traits.effect: Increases the duration of your Magic Energy and Destruction Energy statuses by your Capacity talent's Depth subrank (but they still expire when you use Fire Breath.) For Channel Magic, boosts your FP Recovery by your Capacity talent's Absorption subrank.

traits.name: Disaster Realised
traits.effect: Channel Destruction's effect now destroys existing field objects with Hardiness 10 or less before it places Cinders. If it was a plant object, it leaves behind a Smokescreen for 3 rounds. The level-based damage bonus for Fire Breath is also increased to your total level (instead of half).

traits.name: Divine Ease
traits.effect: While you have this trait, you will automatically succeed tracing any line for the Strange Sight, Eyes of Elimination, and Divine Eyes skills, even if you do nothing.

traits.name: Divine Eyes
traits.effect: Reduces your maximum HP by 5%. Grants access to an additional special Dagger only attack in battle. It functions similarly to Eyes of Elimination, only you must trace three lines in succession. If you trace all lines perfectly, it will instantly defeat any non-boss, non-player character of an equal or lower level (higher level enemies require a status infliction check). If they are not instantly defeated, they take protection ignoring Slash damage equal to your Level * 4, minus 20 for each mistake.

traits.name: Essence Blast
traits.effect: Grants access to the skill Essence Blast. (Releases a projectile that will travel up to 8 Range that deals Akashic magic damage to the first enemy hit equal to 10 + Scaled WIL + Scaled SAN. The target may also be Burned LV = half of power, Duration = 3 Rounds).

traits.name: Eyes of Elimination
traits.effect: Reduces your maximum HP by 4%. Grants access to a Dagger only attack in battle where you must click and drag from one end of a line to the other without going off the line, boosting your critical damage and chance for that attack if you are successful.

traits.name: Fairy Mirage
traits.effect: Papilion Illusion Trait. (only one can be selected) Invite Insanity's butterflies become fairies instead, and will only ever try to inflict Charm. The success rate is boosted by 10%, the duration by 2 rounds, and the LV of it by 15, as a result.

traits.name: Fasting Vampire
traits.effect: Sets your Essence to 0, negates the effects of Sanguine Crest and Stillness, Darkness, and any bonus damage taken from Holy. Gaining Essence in any way removes this trait, and if it was gained in a battle, you are stunned and inflicted with a status called Feeding Frenzy, disabling the use of all skills for that battle except for Movement and Banquet until your Essence is at least 100 at the start of a round.

traits.name: Feeder
traits.effect: When you use Banquet successfully while you do not have any eaten food active, you gain a Bloodfed food for 5 rounds. (5% HP/FP Regen. Can be overwritten by other foods. Grants a status that increases your essence by 2 every round.)

traits.name: Filthy Fangs
traits.effect: Vampire Fangs Trait. (only one can be selected) Not all fangs are made equally. Yours are rather unclean from feeding on unsavory creatures, causing your Banquet skill to have a chance of inflicting Poison LV X (X = Scaled SAN) for 3 Rounds.

traits.name: Flame Art (Explosion)
traits.effect: Flame Art Trait. (only one can be selected) Fire magic damage not caused by this effect: if at least 50 damage dealt, can critically hit. If successful, instead of increasing damage, deals 25 Fire protection-ignoring magic damage in X Range (2 + Nairyf Energy LV). Salamandra Flame: Can critically hit, dealing 25% additional damage.

traits.name: Flame Art (Poison)
traits.effect: Flame Art Trait. (only one can be selected) Fire magic damage they deal has a chance to inflict Poison LV X (X = GUI/2, max. 15) for 2 rounds. The infliction rate is based on a percentage of Status Infliction, depending on the amount of damage dealt (5% per 10 damage, max 110%).

traits.name: Flame Art (Purification)
traits.effect: Flame Art Trait. (only one can be selected) Salamandra Flame will also remove 1 random beneficial status effect from the target, but gains a 3 round cooldown.

traits.name: Fleeing Rat
traits.effect: Instinct Trait. (only one can be selected) When you trigger Muridae Instinct's On Attacked effect, you try to avoid taking a second hit, gaining +10 Evade and Critical Evade for 2 rounds. However, this also puts Muridae Instinct on a 2 round CD.

traits.name: Friend of Nature
traits.effect: Increases the chance of Seize affecting a Plant/Beast Monster by 5%, and increases the success rate of Converting a Plant/Beast Monster by 20%. If the success rate for Convert exceeds 100%, the excess is treated as a chance for them to join without requiring payment.

requirements.raw: Elf or Doriad Race, Detainment Talent Rank 1+

traits.name: Garden Scale
traits.effect: Snakescale Trait. (only one can be selected) Halves Snakescale's Slash resistance, but grants an equal amount of Earth resistance. Gain +1 Move for the round if you start your turn on a Grass tile or a tile with a plant object. -1 Physical Stamina required for Woodcutting.

traits.name: Greymists
traits.effect: Silvermists no longer requires essence to use (and is treated as if 30 essence was consumed), but gains a 5 Round cooldown. Removed if Fasting Vampire is.

requirements.raw: Fasting Vampire Trait, Fast Healing Trait

traits.name: Grimalkin Instinct
traits.effect: Instead of the normal Instinct (Felidae) bonuses to SKI, CEL, LUC, and GUI. this trait replaces them with SKI, CEL, WIL and RES.

traits.name: Hidden Barrage
traits.effect: Karakuri Weapon trait (only 1 selectable). As part of its construction, this character has a small, concealed firearm-like array in its arm, often shot from the fingers. Replaces your Bare Fists with a Hidden Barrage. (Gun/Fist Weapon.)

traits.name: Hidden Blade
traits.effect: Karakuri Weapon trait (only 1 selectable). As part of its construction, this character has a blade hidden somewhere in their arm, which can be extended and retracted, much like a cat's claw. Replaces your Bare Fists with a Hidden Blade. (Sword/Fist Weapon.)

traits.name: Hidden Snake
traits.effect: Naga Wrap trait. (only one can be selected) Wrap's FP cost increases by 5, but you will slip into the tile behind your target if it is a valid tile. Otherwise, you will spin them to face the same way as you, letting you strike them from behind. (Applies before the attack made by Wrap).

traits.name: High Jump
traits.effect: When you use Rabbit Leap, you also become Airborne at the very start, which can be useful for certain skill combinations.

traits.name: Impact Revive
traits.effect: The Phenex improves their Revive racial skill, giving it +3 Range, causing it to heal for additional HP equal to their VIT stat, as well as knocking back all enemies near the target by 1 square.

traits.name: Insanity Eclipse
traits.effect: Black Rend Trait. (only one can be selected) Increases Black Rend's FP cost by 5 and changes it to target the tile directly behind you. If you use it on an enemy without changing the way you are facing and have exactly 7 momentum, the damage it deals is doubled and ignores momentum.

traits.name: Intoxicating Fangs
traits.effect: Vampire Fangs Trait. (only one can be selected) Not all fangs are made equally. Yours fill your prey with a sense of euphoria, causing your Banquet skill to have a chance of inflicting Charm LV X (X = Scaled SAN) for 3 Rounds.

traits.name: Karakuri Deadly Margin
traits.effect: Grants the skill Karakuri Deadly Margin. This skill must be equipped in your skill pool to have an effect. (Passive. Toggle skill. When on, if your Karakuri Strings aren't exhausted, you can use movement skills, and you take a critical hit; Reduce the critical damage modifier exceeding 100% by half (IE, 150% becomes 125%). This exhausts your Karakuri Strings for 1 round.)

traits.name: Karakuri Longarm
traits.effect: Grants the skill Karakuri Longarm. This skill must be equipped in your skill pool to have an effect. (3M, 5 FP. Targets 1 tile within 4 Range which contains an enemy or yourself. If you target an enemy, you detach your arm to perform a basic attack on them with your unarmed weapon, then pull it back by your strings. If you target yourself, you gain Karakuri Longarm (LV 3, 1 round) and recover 2M. Performing this action exhausts your Karakuri Strings for 1 round, and cannot be used if they're already exhausted.)

traits.name: Karakuri Spinning Top
traits.effect: Grants the skill Karakuri Spinning Top. This skill must be equipped in your skill pool to have an effect. (3M, 5 FP. Targets 1 unoccupied tile within 1 Range, and utilize your Karakuri Strings to enter a spin as you move into that tile. Afterwards, you perform a basic attack on all enemies within 1 Range with your unarmed weapon. Performing this action exhausts your Karakuri Strings for 1 round, and cannot be used if they're already exhausted.)

traits.name: Karakuri Standing Snap
traits.effect: Grants the skill Karakuri Standing Snap. This skill must be equipped in your skill pool to have an effect. (Passive. Toggle skill. If on, if your Karakuri Strings aren't exhausted, and you are Knocked Down while you have at least 1 Momentum; spend 1 Momentum to launch yourself back into a standing posture by tightening your strings in a special way. This instantly cures you of the effect (no other Momentum is consumed). However, the immunity you get from curing it this way only lasts for only 1 round, and doing this exhausts your Karakuri Strings for 1 round.)

traits.name: Keen Eyes
traits.effect: When you fill up a hole (via Digging), there's a chance you may find a small amount of Murai in the dirt (afterwards you won't find any more for 4 in-game hours). Furthermore, your success rate when spotting traps is increased by 10%.

traits.name: Life Drain
traits.effect: Grants access to a skill you can equip, which does the following: (Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and drains them of life focus. Reduces their HP and restores yours by a maximum of 10% of their maximum HP, to a maximum of your WIL. For Vampires. this healing is not reduced, and triggers Sanguine Crest.)

traits.name: Little Cheese
traits.effect: Cheese Trait. (only one can be selected) While you're working with a Big Cheese in the same party, swipin' Something Shiny via Muridae Instinct also grants +4 WIL/GUI as long as you have it. Using a Steal skill successfully also has you bash the target for 10 protection-ignoring Blunt bonus damage, so's you can rough 'em up and teach 'em a lesson. If all of the Big Cheeses are at 0 HP, this don't work anymore. If even one is at 0 HP, you also get -5 FP regeneration, because the boss is disappointed.

traits.name: Long Jump
traits.effect: Unlocks the passive skill Long Jump. This skill must be equipped in your skill pool to take effect. (Why jump far when you can jump even farther? Increases the maximum range of Rabbit Leap by 3.)

traits.name: Lunar Cleansing
traits.effect: Lunatism Trait. (only one can be selected) The power of lunatism washes over your mind, purifying it. When you activate Lunar Lunatism, you cure yourself of Fear, Hesitation, Charm, and Confusion, and become immune to those effects for its duration. However, the Essence cost of it increases by 5.

traits.name: Lunar Madness
traits.effect: Lunatism Trait. (only one can be selected) The power of lunatism turns you into a barbarian, granting 10 Armor and 10 Magic Armor penetration while active, but also inflicting Confusion on yourself as a substatus tied to Lunar Lunatism. (Substatuses last as long as the main status does.)

traits.name: Lunar Swiftness
traits.effect: Lunatism Trait. (only one can be selected) The power of lunatism grants you superhuman speed, Increasing your Move by 1 and Evade by 10 for its duration. However, the Essence per-round cost of it increases by 5.

traits.name: Magical Voice
traits.effect: Reduces the stamina required to use Performance by 1 (min 1 - no change for manual performances). Your beautiful songs will increase the LV and duration of Performance buff status effects by 5 each.

traits.name: Oni Enrage
traits.effect: Sometimes, getting angry is enough to get the Oni's blood burning. Grants the skill Oni Enrage (which must be equipped in the skill pool). (0M, 0FP, 5 Round CD. Can only be used while you are Ruled By Anger. Your Oni blood grows hot, and you gain Sanguine Crest (LV 1, 2 rounds, doesn't inflict Burnout) and put Banquet (Oni) on a 2 round CD.)

requirements.raw: Oni Race, Ruled By Emotion Trait

traits.name: Oni Heritage (Blue)
traits.effect: Oni Heritage trait (only 1 selectable). The character's dominant Oni blood comes from Blue Oni, known for their storm-like presence. Causes your Hazing Blood to deal Lightning damage, makes it grant you a 15% Lightning Resistance and a 15% Earth Weakness, and your Sanguine Crest to grant an additional +2 LUC.

traits.name: Oni Heritage (Red)
traits.effect: Oni Heritage trait (only 1 selectable). The character's dominant Oni blood comes from Red Oni, known for their heat and power. Causes your Hazing Blood to deal Fire damage, makes it grant you a 15% Fire Resistance and a 15% Light Weakness, and your Sanguine Crest to grant an additional +2 STR.

traits.name: Overload Magic
traits.effect: Grants access to a toggle skill called Overload Magic. When on, you gain +15 Spell Power but your Offensive category spells cost 25% more FP. Does not apply to spells requiring Invocations.

traits.name: Pack Alpha
traits.effect: Pack Trait. (only one can be selected) Pack Followers can benefit from your Hunted status effects at 50% effectiveness (every additional Pack Alpha in the party reduces the effectiveness of this).

traits.name: Pack Follower
traits.effect: Pack Trait. (only one can be selected) If there is only one Pack Alpha in your party, the post-battle HP/FP Regeneration for you and all Pack Follower party members is increased by 3% each. Furthermore, you can benefit from a Pack Alpha's Hunted status effects at 50% effectiveness (every additional Pack Alpha in the party reduces the effectiveness of this).

traits.name: Painful Grip
traits.effect: When you successfully use Grapple on an enemy, they also take Protection-ignoring Pierce physical damage equal to 15 + Twice your Scaled STR.

traits.name: Patient Preordinance
traits.effect: Preordinance Trait. (only one can be selected) Rather than every third Round, your Preordinance activates every fourth round (instead of third), but the LV of the Disengage Effect becomes 25 (instead of 15).

traits.name: Play Cute
traits.effect: Grants a special skill in battle called Play Cute'. (You roll around on the ground in a cute fashion, giving you a chance to Charm all enemies within 5 Range (LV = 5 + Scaled SAN/2) for 3 rounds. If you are Burned, the rolling is less cute, removing the Charm chance but reducing the Burn duration by 2 rounds. Either way, you will also destroy any special effect tile with Hardiness 2 or lower in your current location.)

traits.name: Poison Rush
traits.effect: Gaining Poison through your Poison Bite or Absorb Poison skills will trigger Battle Rush (if already active, the duration extends by 1 round).

traits.name: Pure Instinct
traits.effect: Instinct skills that activate at certain HP percentages activate at 25% higher HP than they say (IE, 50% or less becomes 75% or less). Fear of Death (where you are inflicted with Fear by enemies who damage you while you are at 15% HP or less) is also affected somewhat, making it apply at 25% HP or less instead.

traits.name: Ram Tactics
traits.effect: Unlocks a special skill in battle called Ram. (Ram your horns into the target, dealing Pierce damage equal to 20 + your Scaled STR. If the target is using an Unarmored torso, they take 50% more damage.)

requirements.raw: Zeran, Reaper or Apertaurus Race, 15 STR

traits.name: Red Skies
traits.effect: Grants them access to the Gain Air racial skill.

traits.name: Remove Impurities
traits.effect: When you use your Absorb Poison skill on an ally, the Poison status you receive has its LV increased by 10, but you also heal that ally for the same amount of HP (after the increase). Furthermore, other negative status conditions they are suffering from have their durations reduced by 1 round.

traits.name: Revolver Raid Cannon
traits.effect: Mech Type Trait. (only one can be selected) Made to take down a target without any hesitation and with no other tools required, the Revolver Raid Cannon becomes your new method of attack when you have no weapon equipped. (Firearms scaling, 20 Power, 100 Accuracy, 0 Critical, 0 Weight, 1 Round, 4 Range. Enchanted with Rampaging, which lowers the defense of targets hit.)

traits.name: Sand Scale
traits.effect: Snakescale Trait. (only one can be selected) Halves Snakescale's Slash resistance, but grants an equal amount of Wind resistance. Gain +1 Move for the round if you start your turn on a Desert tile or a tile with an Air Shaft. -1 Physical Stamina required for Digging.

traits.name: Sea Dread
traits.effect: Song Trait. (only one can be selected) Grants a special skill in battle called Theno's Dread. (All enemies within 5 range take sound magic damage equal to 150% of your Sound ATK, and tries to inflict them with Fear and Interference for 3 rounds. Can't be used if Silenced, and requires 1 Physical Stamina per use.)

traits.name: Sea Scale
traits.effect: Snakescale Trait. (only one can be selected) Halves Snakescale's Slash resistance, but grants an equal amount of Water resistance. Gain +1 Move for the round if you start your turn on a Ocean tile or a tile with Dark Water. -1 Physical Stamina required for Diving.

traits.name: Sea Star
traits.effect: Song Trait. (only one can be selected) Grants a special skill in battle called Theno's Joy. (4M. 2 round cooldown. Gives all allies Regeneration LV X (X = 25% of WIL, min. 3) for 3 rounds. If fighting against only monsters, all allies gain 1 Momentum this round. Can't be used if Silenced and requires 1 Physical Stamina to use.)

traits.name: Sharp Claws
traits.effect: When using a Fist weapon, On Hit: Deals protection ignoring slash damage equal to half of your scaled STR, but also makes you lose HP equal to half of that.

requirements.raw: Lupine, Felidae, Grimalkin or Shaitan Race

traits.name: Snake Mirage
traits.effect: Papilion Illusion Trait. (only one can be selected) Invite Insanity's butterflies become snakes instead, and will only ever try to inflict Poison. The success rate is boosted by 10%, the duration by 2 rounds, and the LV of it by 10, as a result.

traits.name: Soul Generator
traits.effect: Grants access to the Soul Generator passive skill. (While this skill is equipped, when you select End Turn you recover FP equal to your unspent Momentum * 2 (Excess Momentum from a lack of possible actions is also transferred in this manner.))

traits.name: Soul Rage
traits.effect: Grants access to the Soul Rage active skill. (By using this skill, you invoke a Soul Rage for 3 rounds, increasing your Momentum by 3 immediately, and the Momentum you start your turn with by 3, for 3 rounds. However, you cannot cast spells and lose 10% of your Maximum HP every round this is active.))

traits.name: Sound Skies
traits.effect: Grants them access to the Flight racial skill.

traits.name: Spirit Shell
traits.effect: Prevents possessed Spirits from fleeing your body when defeated.

traits.name: Stomper
traits.effect: Rabbit Leap normally gives you Rabbit Foot, but if you use it while you already have it, you will land at the end and deal Earth magic damage to all enemies within 3 Range equal to your level + 100% your Earth ATK. If you are Airborne the status is ended and the damage is further increased by 50%.

traits.name: Strange Sight
traits.effect: Reduces your maximum HP by 1%. Boosts the speed of your mining and woodchopping by 50%.

traits.name: Sturdy Standard Body
traits.effect: Mech Type Trait. (only one can be selected) While you have no torso item equipped, you are treated as having 10 Armor, 10 Magic Armor, 15 Evade, and your Maximum HP is increased by your character level * 2 (min. 30).

traits.name: Swift Preordinance
traits.effect: Preordinance Trait. (only one can be selected) Rather than every third Round, your Preordinance activates every second round, but the LV of the Disengage Effect becomes 10 (instead of 15).

traits.name: Synthetic Hair
traits.effect: Highly durable synthetic hair protects what it covers, giving a +3 Armor bonus.

traits.name: Tear of the Moon
traits.effect: Grants access to a special skill called Tear of the Moon in battle. (For 3 rounds negate the damage resistance and weakness modifications of The Mark, and gain +5 FP regeneration. At night, the duration is doubled.)

traits.name: Tree Person
traits.effect: In battle, tiles that are within 1 cardinal step of your location are treated as if they have plant objects in them. (This is used to interact with some skill effects.)

traits.name: Tribe - Bornui
traits.effect: Tribe Trait. (only one can be selected) 10% Outgoing Healing if the recipient is a Kaelensia/Beast unit. You are also treated as both a Pack Follower and a Pack Alpha (if no other ones are in the party), letting you work well with Lupine Kaelensia (only takes effect if there are Lupines with Pack Traits. Felidae Kaelensia using the Play Cute skill are supported by you, increasing the LV by 5, and the success rate by 5% Hunter's Elegance Preferred Weapon: Dagger.

traits.name: Tribe - Eu Lan Yi
traits.effect: Tribe Trait. (only one can be selected) 10% Status Infliction versus Serpentkind and Snakemen. Grants a skill in battle called Charm Serpent. (Requires an instrument weapon equipped. Play your instrument, which targets all Serpentkind and Snakemen enemies within 5 range. All of those enemies in that range take Sound magic damage equal to your Sound ATK, and have a chance to be inflicted with Charm (LV = 50% of Scaled SAN) and Confusion. Both effects last 3 rounds.)

traits.name: Tribe - Redrayder
traits.effect: Tribe Trait. (only one can be selected) Reduces Capture's Hit and Damage penalty, and increases Convert's success rate by 10%. In addition, if you hit an enemy with a basic attack during Round 1, they cannot use items for 3 Rounds (doubled for non-player characters). Hunter's Elegance Preferred Weapon: Axe.

traits.name: Unchained Wings
traits.effect: Using [[[Dragon Hover]]] while you are Restrained by or Restraining an enemy causes both of you to become Airborne, and breaks the restrain effect. If you are the one being restrained, however, the cost of Dragon Hover increases to 3M.

traits.name: Venom Darkness
traits.effect: Venom Trait. (only one can be selected) Increases the cost of Poison Bite to 10 FP and reduces its LV by 5. Your venom is unique in the sense that, when an enemy is affected by it, it also inflicts a Blind substatus. (Substatuses last as long as the main status does).

traits.name: Venom Drive (Flame)
traits.effect: Increases your Fire ATK by 10 when inflicted with Poison status.

traits.name: Venom Fatigue
traits.effect: Venom Trait. (only one can be selected) Increases the cost of Poison Bite to 10 FP and reduces its LV by 5. Your venom is unique in the sense that, it interferes with your enemies' ability to coordinate, it also inflicts a Clumsy substatus.Clumsy prevents the use of movement skills, except basic movement. (Substatuses last as long as the main status does).

traits.name: Venom Fury
traits.effect: Venom Trait. (only one can be selected) Increases the cost of Poison Bite to 10 FP and reduces its LV by 5. Your venom is unique in the sense that, enemies have trouble differentiating friend from foe while under its effects, it also inflicts a Confusion substatus. (Substatuses last as long as the main status does).

traits.name: Versatile Roles
traits.effect: Boosts Power of Bow weapons, healing from First Aid's Healing subtalent, quality of special foods made by the Cooking talent, and Maximum FP by 3 each.

traits.name: Violent Snake
traits.effect: Naga Wrap trait. (only one can be selected) Wrap's FP cost increases by 10, but if you use it on an enemy you are Restraining or Grappling, it will inflict Blunt protection-ignoring physical damage equal to your Scaled STR and knock the enemy down, but release them.

traits.name: Voices of the Past
traits.effect: Every so often, while near locations people have spoken in, you may hear an echo of the conversation that took place. (Does not function in Dungeons, camps, player houses, etc.)

traits.name: Welcome Corruption
traits.effect: APT will no longer increase your SAN. (can benefit certain Corrupted racial skills.)

traits.name: Arcane Tattoo (Barrier)
traits.effect: -1% Maximum HP. At the start of a battle, automatically consumes 5 FP and gains a status effect that decreases the first instance of non-bonus, non-status damage recieved by 50%.

traits.name: Arcane Tattoo (Fist)
traits.effect: -1% Maximum HP. Enhances your unarmed weapon (the weapon used when you have none equipped, such as Basic Fists) by granting it the Magical tag (-30% Main Stat, +40% WIL scaling) and allowing it to be used as a casting tool.

requirements.raw: Race with Natural Skin, 20 WIL, 20 STR

traits.name: Arcane Tattoo (Lust)
traits.effect: -1% Maximum HP. At the start of a battle, automatically consumes 10 FP and has a chance to inflict all enemies with Charm LV 15 for 3 rounds. If you have the Lovely Face Trait, the success rate is increased by 10%.

requirements.raw: Race with Natural Skin, 20 WIL, 20 GUI

traits.name: Arcane Tattoo (Warding)
traits.effect: -1% Maximum HP. At the start of a battle, automatically consumes 5 FP and increases your Status Resistance by 40% for the first infliction-based status that is attempted on you in battle.

requirements.raw: Race with Natural Skin, 20 WIL, 20 FAI

traits.name: Spiritual Tattoo (Obedience)
traits.effect: -1% Maximum HP. Augments your Youkai contracts to make them more obedient, preventing Youkai from refusing Install requests or unsummoning themself (excluding lacking FP to maintain them), and granting them +30% Status Resistance versus Confusion. Includes yourself if treated as a Youkai via Install, etc.)
